name: West grandstand south annex, east
summary: A low rectangular pavilion sits at the south end of the home stand. Its grey gable roof runs roughly north to south.

evidence.note: Two separate rectangular roofs lie immediately below the west grandstand in plan. Each has a central ridge with a darker west slope. PIL sample (175,1312).
Regional 2 m grid, heights above local ground. Median 4.61 m, P90 5.18 m, maximum 5.27 m. Roof peaks agree with shallow pitches on these approximately 13 m-wide pavilions.
Search to 120 m found no oriented street view of a wall. Cladding, surface finish and the single service opening on the paved side are inferred.

notes: Roof and footprint are visible. The dark narrow gap separates the two pavilions. Wall construction, service door and eaves are estimates. A small object against the east wall may be a service door or utility cabinet. Roof finish and both door positions are inferred.
